gui.tccloud.not_owner: Only %s can open this TC Cloud Link.
gui.tccloud.help:
Your cloud channel: items stored here follow you to other servers of the same owner.
Left click: take a stack · Right click: take 1
With an item on the cursor: left stores all, right stores 1
Shift-click in your inventory: store the stack
Channel row: ◀ ▶ choose this Link's channel, + creates one, ✎ renames it.
